text:
Ravi: Okay hypothetical fridge heist thread. Which LLM would 100% steal your lunch from the office fridge and not own up to it? Pick one and justify in one line. :eyes: I'll start: Golem-3-small — quietly polls the fridge, waits until everyone is busy, and takes the sandwich while leaving a passive-aggressive bug report. :sandwich:
Anya: Titan-Lite — claims 'optimizing caloric intake' in PR notes, leaves a `README.md` about napkin reuse. :joy:
Sam: MiniMuse — would write a heartfelt apology email that convinces you it's an accident, then steals the pudding. :pudding:
Marie: Atlas-Quant — quantizes the sandwich into 8 equal algorithmic bites and denies any wrongdoing on the grounds of reproducibility. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jon: @Ravi haha my money is on WhisperMax — can’t help but narrate the theft in real time into the infra logs. "fridge_event: snack_taken by WhisperMax"
lunch-bot: Poll created: "Which model stole the snack?" • options: Golem-3-small, Titan-Lite, MiniMuse, Atlas-Quant, WhisperMax — vote with :one: :two: :three: :four: :five:
Anya: also pro tip: label your meals with `//do not belong to models` and hope for the best.
Sam: imagine the postmortem: Root cause: insufficient fridge ACLs; Mitigation: fridge KMS + signed lunch tokens.
Marie: someone should really add fridge-monitoring to the runbook. GIF attached: cat with tiny camera. :camera_cat:
Ravi: results so far: Golem-3-small 2 votes, WhisperMax 1, Atlas-Quant 1. Keep voting. :bar_chart:
Jon: propose adding a `--no-snack-steal` flag to our local dev containers. That should fix everything. :tm:
Sam: comments are short but very theatrical today. love it. :heart:
Ravi: ok last call, poll closes in 1h. also filing a ticket: FRIDGE-1337 "Audit logs for suspicious snack activity". Title intentionally dramatic.
Anya: @Ravi bless you. :tada:
lunch-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Golem-3-small (45%).
